name: Project Create Flow
description: Creates a Project from the shared Folder acquisition menu through either manual path entry or one injected native existing-Folder capability.

states: Open the Project section add menu, choose Select Folder, and inspect the browser path-entry dialog.
Inspect the disabled New Folder command without replacing the shared Folder acquisition menu.
Open the Project section add menu, choose Select Folder, and confirm that the injected native capability creates the Project without rendering the manual path dialog.
Inspect the resulting Project, first Folder, Primary Workspace, and terminal projection while New Folder remains disabled.

useWhen: A Workbench host starts Project creation from a selected Folder or an equivalent platform folder capability.
Browser and desktop hosts must share one entry menu and diverge only at the Folder acquisition boundary.
avoidWhen: An existing Project is gaining another Folder; use the Project manager flow instead.
The caller already owns a Project descriptor and does not need user-facing Folder acquisition.
invariants: The Project add trigger always opens the shared Folder acquisition menu before any platform-specific input.
Browser composition accepts a manually entered absolute path without claiming that the path was verified.
Desktop composition uses one injected existing-Folder capability, renders no parallel manual path dialog, and admits at most one selection.
Cancellation, bounded failure, unmount, and late completion after disposal cannot create a Project.
Successful creation atomically creates the Project, first Folder, Primary Workspace, and terminal projection.
